events.title: US-China framework agreement in Kuala Lumpur; 100% tariff threat removed
events.why_it_matters: Removes the most severe tail risk for tech supply chains and global trade ahead of the November 1 tariff deadline.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the framework holds after Monday's market open and details on tariff reductions.

events.title: Trump waives Russia energy sanctions; suspends 100% tariffs on India/China
events.why_it_matters: Lowers oil supply risk and removes a tariff overhang for major EM importers, but signals unpredictable US policy.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Russia can actually increase exports amid Ukrainian strikes on energy infrastructure.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh dovish remarks; October hike odds fall to ~16%
events.why_it_matters: Reduces the probability of a pre-election hike and supports duration-sensitive growth stocks.
events.what_to_watch: Fed blackout period and the October 27-28 FOMC statement for any hawkish dissent.

events.title: US September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y; core 2.6%
events.why_it_matters: Sticky inflation keeps the Fed hawkish and raises the bar for rate cuts into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: September PCE on October 29 for confirmation that inflation is broadening.

events.title: US September retail sales +0.8% m/m, well above expectations
events.why_it_matters: Consumer resilience supports the soft-landing narrative despite weak payrolls and hot inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Whether stronger sales persist into the holiday season.

events.title: TSMC Q3 beat-and-raise; record profit and strong Q4 guidance
events.why_it_matters: Confirms AI chip demand remains robust and supports the semiconductor supply chain.
events.what_to_watch: Whether TSMC's capex guidance lifts equipment makers and AI-linked names.

events.title: ASML Q3 record sales and strong guidance
events.why_it_matters: Signals sustained AI-driven demand for advanced lithography and boosts the European tech complex.
events.what_to_watch: Order book and 2027 outlook commentary.

events.title: JPMorgan Q3 profit miss, first since 2023
events.why_it_matters: High rates are pressuring bank margins and credit costs, a warning for the financial sector.
events.what_to_watch: Loan-loss provisions and net interest income guidance from other banks.

events.title: China Q3 GDP +4.5% y/y, at bottom of target range
events.why_it_matters: Growth is stabilizing but remains unbalanced, with weak consumption and property.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Beijing announces additional stimulus after the midterm US elections.

events.title: China September retail sales +1.1%, industrial production +5.5%
events.why_it_matters: Confirms a two-speed economy: factories strong, households cautious.
events.what_to_watch: Policy support for consumption and property.

events.title: India Supreme Court strikes down Yes Bank AT1 write-off
events.why_it_matters: Restores ₹8,415 crore to bondholders and sets a precedent for AT1 instruments globally.
events.what_to_watch: Yes Bank shares and potential regulatory appeal.

events.title: Fed Beige Book: modest growth, rising price pressures
events.why_it_matters: Supports a hawkish hold at the October FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Anecdotes on tariffs and labor costs.

events.title: Tech selloff; Nasdaq worst week since April 2025
events.why_it_matters: AI capex and valuation concerns are driving a broad de-risking in technology.
events.what_to_watch: Mega-cap earnings this week and next for signs of capex discipline.

events.title: UAW strike ends after tentative GM deal
events.why_it_matters: Removes a supply-chain disruption for GM and the auto sector.
events.what_to_watch: Ratification vote and whether the deal sets a pattern for other automakers.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on US Gulf Coast
events.why_it_matters: Gulf Coast landfall can disrupt oil/gas production and refining, with insurance losses.
events.what_to_watch: Damage assessments and production restarts.

events.title: China LPR decision
events.why_it_matters: A cut would signal additional stimulus; a hold suggests caution ahead of US midterms.
events.what_to_watch: 1-year and 5-year LPR rates.

events.title: Netflix Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Ad-tier and engagement trends set the tone for streaming and media.
events.what_to_watch: Subscriber growth, ARM, and ad-tier commentary.

events.title: Tesla Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: EV demand, margins, and autonomy/robotaxi updates are key for the sector and Musk premium.
events.what_to_watch: Auto gross margin and 2027 delivery guidance.

events.title: Meta Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AI capex and ad demand will test the market's tolerance for spending.
events.what_to_watch: Capex guidance for 2027 and Reels monetization.

events.title: Bank of Korea decision
events.why_it_matters: Hold expected at 3.00%, but guidance on a November hike matters for KRW and Korean assets.
events.what_to_watch: Vote split and language on household debt.

events.title: Japan national CPI (September)
events.why_it_matters: Informs the BOJ's December decision; yen and JGBs are sensitive.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI excluding fresh food.

events.title: Microsoft fiscal Q1 2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Azure growth is the key test of AI infrastructure demand.
events.what_to_watch: Azure constant-currency growth vs ~45% guide and capex.

events.title: FOMC meeting
events.why_it_matters: Decision sets the rates tone into year-end; market prices ~84% hold.
events.what_to_watch: Statement language on inflation and the December hike.

events.title: Alphabet Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Search and cloud growth will be a key read on AI monetization.
events.what_to_watch: Google Cloud margins and capex commentary.

events.title: US Q3 GDP advance estimate
events.why_it_matters: GDPNow tracked ~4.6%, but shutdown data gaps may distort the print.
events.what_to_watch: Consumer spending and inventory contribution.

events.title: US PCE inflation (September)
events.why_it_matters: The Fed's preferred gauge; a hot core print would cement a December hike.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE m/m and y/y.

events.title: ECB rate decision
events.why_it_matters: Hold expected, but guidance on December is key for EUR and bunds.
events.what_to_watch: Lagarde's press conference on inflation and growth.

events.title: BOJ policy meeting
events.why_it_matters: Hold expected, but any hint of a December hike will move the yen and JGBs.
events.what_to_watch: Outlook report and Ueda's press conference.

events.title: Amazon Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AWS growth and retail margins are key for the AI and consumer narratives.
events.what_to_watch: AWS growth and operating income guidance.

events.title: European and Mediterranean port strike
events.why_it_matters: More than 40 ports handling ~40% of Mediterranean container throughput could face disruption.
events.what_to_watch: Duration and spread to inland logistics.

events.title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting
events.why_it_matters: Production policy will be set against Strait of Hormuz disruption and Russia sanctions relief.
events.what_to_watch: Whether quotas are raised or held to defend prices.

events.title: Apple fiscal Q4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: iPhone demand and services growth are key for the largest market cap.
events.what_to_watch: iPhone revenue and China commentary.

events.title: US midterm elections
events.why_it_matters: Polls suggest Republicans could lose the House and maybe the Senate, reshaping fiscal and regulatory expectations.
events.what_to_watch: Senate and House control, and implications for the December funding fight.

top_risks: FOMC hawkish surprise or a hot September PCE print that revives December hike pricing.
Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz or Iran resuming attacks, spiking oil and risk premiums.
Mega-cap tech earnings disappoint on AI capex or margins, extending the Nasdaq selloff.
US midterm outcome creates fiscal or regulatory uncertainty, complicating the December funding deadline.
European port strike disrupts Mediterranean supply chains and adds to goods inflation.
top_opportunities: US-China tariff de-escalation removes a major tail risk for semiconductors, industrials, and global trade.
Dovish Warsh and a likely FOMC hold support duration-sensitive growth stocks and bonds.
TSMC/ASML results confirm robust AI infrastructure demand, validating the semiconductor complex.
OPEC+ supply decision could stabilize oil if quotas are held, easing inflation pressure.
Post-midterm clarity could unlock deal activity and fiscal negotiations, lifting risk appetite.
summary: Markets enter the last two weeks of October with a dovish Fed on hold, hot September CPI, and a major US-China tariff de-escalation that removes the November 1 tail risk. Mega-cap earnings, the October 28 FOMC, and the November 3 midterms dominate the upcoming window, while Strait of Hormuz disruption and a European port strike keep supply-chain risks alive.
